description: Diaspora business search. Search the Ni Biashara diaspora business registry: 2,864 African and Black diaspora businesses across 424 metros and 91 categories. Filter by text, metro, category, city, verification status and channels on file; records carry contacts, directory page and claim state, with the snapshot date disclosed. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

category.description: exact registry category, e.g. Restaurants & Food (optional)

has.description: channel on file: website, phone, instagram or facebook; repeatable or comma-separated (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

metro.description: metro to filter, e.g. DFW, Houston, Toronto (optional)

q.description: free text over name, category, city and blurb (optional)

name: search_diaspora_businesses
title: Diaspora business search
